title: Anchoring the next-generation platform's first modules
summary: The delivery head named me anchor for the first modules of the exchange's next-generation platform: application, pre-screener and My Accounts, each with its own development team.
what_would_have_happened: Not applicable: this was a role assignment.
the_call: Carry the lessons of the old platform into the new one.
what_i_did: Anchored the teams building the three modules toward a planned October delivery, while other release streams ran in parallel.
what_changed: I became the India anchor for the platform meant to replace the one I had helped stabilize.
